info.name: ScheduleMate API
info.description:
# ScheduleMate — Lecture Hall Digital Signage System
**Sparkline Academy**

Complete API collection for the ScheduleMate backend.

## How to Use
1. Import both this collection and the `ScheduleMate-Local.postman_environment.json` file.
2. Select the **ScheduleMate — Local** environment.
3. Run **Auth → Login** first — the token is automatically saved to the environment.
4. All protected endpoints will use the saved token automatically.

## Authentication
All admin endpoints require a valid JWT. After login the `accessToken` is captured in the `token` environment variable and sent as a `Bearer` header automatically via the collection-level pre-request script.

## API Base URL
`http://localhost:3001/api`

request.description:
Creates a session with conflict detection for both room and lecturer.

**sessionType options:** `LECTURE`, `TUTORIAL`, `PRACTICAL`, `LABORATORY`, `EXAM`, `MEETING`, `EVENT`, `OTHER`

**Conflict rules:**
- A room cannot have two overlapping SCHEDULED sessions
- A lecturer cannot have two overlapping SCHEDULED sessions
This request overlaps with the previously created session in the same room. Expected: **409 Conflict**.
Partially updates a session. Conflict checks re-run if room, lecturer, or times change.
Marks a session as CANCELLED. Cancelled sessions are excluded from all public signage views.

item.name: 📺 Display Configurations
item.description: Configure digital signage displays. Each display has a unique key and is scoped to a room, side, floor, or building.

request.description:
Creates a room-scoped display. The `displayKey` must be globally unique.

**Scope options (provide exactly one):**
- `roomId` — single room display
- `sideId` — all rooms on a side
- `floorId` — all rooms on a floor
- `buildingId` — all rooms in a building

request.description:
Fetches the signage payload for a display identified by its unique key.

**Room-scope response includes:**
- `occupancyStatus`: `OCCUPIED` | `AVAILABLE` | `UPCOMING_SOON`
- `currentSession`: currently running session or null
- `nextSession`: next upcoming session or null
- `recentlyCompletedSessions`: sessions that ended in the last 2 hours

**Area-scope (building/floor/side) response includes:**
- `rooms[]`: array of rooms, each with their own occupancy status

> Change `LH-101-MAIN` to any valid `displayKey` in your system.
Fetches a multi-room overview display. Returns `rooms[]` with occupancy status for each room.

Returns current occupancy status for a room identified by its unique `code` (e.g. `LH-101`).

> Change `LH-101` to any valid room `code` in your system.
